identity.template: A crisp two-tone vector silhouette pictogram. Subject: {prompt}. Depict exactly this subject and its requested pose, with recognizable proportions and distinctive outer features. One complete solid jet-black cut-paper shape centered on a pure white square canvas. The subject occupies the central 70 percent of the canvas, with a wide empty white margin on every side. Keep the whole subject visible, including extremities. Use a clean, simple continuous outer boundary. Flat black fill throughout the subject; blank white outside. The image contains only the subject silhouette, without lettering, decorations, a frame, scenery, shadows, texture or a surrounding badge.
